name: 78516 · Alamo, TX
findings: ZIP 78516 (Alamo) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78516 (Alamo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
